title: NEW ORLEANS VEAL BALLS
instructions: Chop fine a pound of young veal. Season with salt,  pepper,  thyme and onion juice. Roll this in balls. Let them brown in a saucepan with butter an hour before you have prepared the sauce. --JOSEPHINE NICAUD.
